name: Weighted crunch
notes: Crunch holding a dumbbell or plate. Record the load being held.

guide.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a dumbbell against the chest or over the head.
guide.execution: Curl the shoulder blades off the floor by shortening through the abs, then lower under control.
guide.cues: Move the ribs toward the hips. Keep the neck relaxed. Pause briefly at the top.
guide.mistakes: Pulling on the neck; hinging at the hips instead of flexing the spine; using momentum; lowering too quickly.
